book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas nɨmam hain nɨp manö hagla
Hainö pen Juda bɨ kub gau Jisas nɨp alnɨg geila nɨŋöm Jisas ram mɨnöŋ Judia gau ajagmɨdöp; ram mɨnöŋ Galili gau nöp ajmɨdöp.
Pen Juda ñɨn kub kale, ram bada pro göm ñɨn rɨmnap hanbal ñɨn u söl söl ga nɨŋöm,
Jisas nɨmam hain gau mɨdeia u apöm nɨp hagla, “Ne mɨgan anɨbi arö gɨmön ram mɨnöŋ Judia ammön, nɨbi bɨ manö nöp nɨŋbal gau kalɨp nan gagep rö gɨpan u gö nɨŋnaböl.

Bɨ kale bɨ kub mɨdnɨg gɨnaböl gau, nan kale gau pi göm gagnaböl; waiö yabɨƚ gɨnaböl. Anɨb u, ne nan ke yabɨƚ gɨpan rö, nɨbi bɨ iru mɨdpal aŋ au nan gagep rɨmnap gö, nɨbi bɨ magöŋhalö nɨŋnaböl,” a gɨla.
Pen Jisas nɨmam nɨpe ke gau nɨp nɨŋ udagla.
Anɨg hageila, Jisas pen kalɨp haga, “Kale ñɨn mai arun a gɨnabim u arnɨg arnabim; pen ñɨn yad arep u auagöp nɨŋöm yade uri aragnabin.
Nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i gau, kalöp bɨ mulu kal nɨŋöl iƚ ap mɨdagöp. Pen yad nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i gau, nan si nan naij gɨpal u hag waiö lɨnö yɨp mulu kal nɨŋbal.
Anɨb u, Ram Bada ñɨn kub söl auab rö, kale Jerusalem armim; pen yad ñɨn arep u auagöp rö, yad aip aragnabin,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ Galili mɨdeia.
Ram Bada ñɨn kub aua nɨŋöm Jisas Jerusalem ara
Pen Jisas nɨmam bɨ gau Jerusalem arla nɨŋöm Jisas nɨpe agamɨj hain ara.
Juda bɨ kub gau, “Jisas mai?” ö göm, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp ap mɨdeila gau kalɨp hag nɨŋla.
Pen nɨbi bɨ yɨharɨŋ gau, Jisas manö u kale ke hag nɨŋ hag nɨŋ göm, rɨmnap hagla, “Nɨpe bɨ aij ap,” a gɨla; rɨmnap pen hagla, “Wasö, nɨpe nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp wai ñöb bɨ,” a gɨla.
Pen nɨbi bɨ yɨharɨŋ gau, Juda bɨ kub anɨb gau kalɨp pɨñɨŋ gɨla rö, kale manö rɨmnap waiö hagagla.
Ram Bada ñɨn kub kale anɨbu ñɨn rɨmnap padia. Yöp ñɨn bad ap nöp mɨdö, Jisas apjaköm, God sabe gep ram u amöm, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp manö hag ña.
Jisas manö hag ñɨ mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, Juda bɨ kub gau aiö göm hagla, “Bɨ i skul hagaga u pen aigöl göm manö gau magöŋhalö nɨŋöb?” ö gɨla.
Anɨg hageila, Jisas haga, “Manö yad hag ñabin u, gasɨ yad ke nɨŋem hag ñagabin; Bɨ yɨp hag yuö aunö u nöp yɨp gasɨ ñö hag ñabin.
Nɨbi bɨ an, God hagöp rö gɨnam, a göm, gɨ ud arnab u, God nɨpe manö yɨp ñab hagabin aka manö yad ke hagabin u, nɨŋnab.

Kale nɨŋbim, nɨbi bɨ an manö nɨpe ke hagnab u, hib yad ap rannɨm, a göm, manö gau nɨbö gau nɨbö udöm hagnab. Pen bɨ an nɨpe bɨ nɨpe hag yua hib nɨpe nöp ap rannɨm, a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋnab u, bɨ anɨbu bɨ kabö göl manö nɨŋö nöp hagab; nɨpe manö piral rɨmnap hagagnab.
Mosɨs, God haga haga rö kalɨp lo manö hag ña u pen lo adö anɨb gau kale bɨ ap gagpim. Pen yad manö ap mɨdöp wasö, yɨp yɨharɨŋ alnɨg gabim,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagö, nɨbi bɨ ap mɨdeila gau hagla, “Nöp an alnɨg gab? Nöp kɨjaki abaŋ lajɨp hagabön,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Jisas haga, “Yad nan gagep añɨ ap gɨnö, kale magöŋhalö pa gɨƚɨ gɨpe.

Kale Mosɨs God lo manö haga rö, ñɨ kale gau yag daumim, ñɨn unbö mudun jɨŋ u mɨdmim, ruö raleb ñɨn u waŋ hañ rɨkpim. Gɨpim anɨbu, Mosɨs nɨpe wasö, nahai iƚaŋ bɨ nöd iƚ göm gɨmɨdal nagɨ adö u me anɨg gɨpim. Pen hañ rɨkep ñɨn raleb anɨbu, ñɨn rɨmnap God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u nöp lɨnab, pen mɨñi God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u, a gɨmim, arö gagpim; haƚöwaƚö hañ rɨkpim. Gɨpim anɨbu rö, yad God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u bɨ ap nɨp gɨnö, hañ romaŋ magöŋhalö kamɨŋ löp u, kale ai gɨnɨg yɨp nɨŋbe mulu lugöp?
Anɨb u, hainö manö adö adö nöp nɨŋmim hagagmim; kabö rö gɨnab adö u nɨŋ aij gɨmim hagmim,” a ga.
“Jisas me Krais u aka?” gɨla
Jerusalem nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hagla, “Juda bɨ kub gau bɨ alnɨg gaböl bɨ me i aka?
Pen nɨŋim! Nɨpe nɨbi bɨ aŋ kub i manö hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, pen manö ap hagagaböl. Anɨb u, kale ke nɨŋbal nɨpe Krais u yɨjɨg göl rö löp!
Pen nɨpe Krais u auböp u, hon nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ gai nɨbö auöp u nɨŋagbnop; pen bɨ i nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ gai nɨbö auöp u hon magöŋhalö nɨŋbun. Anɨb u, nɨpe Krais u wasö,” gɨla.

Pen Jisas nɨpe God sabe gep ram raul yaŋ manö hag ñöl gɨ nöp mɨdöm, meg magö dap ranöm haga, “Kale gasɨ nɨŋbim, kale yɨp nɨŋ aij yabɨƚ gɨmim, gai nɨbö aunö u nɨŋbim. Pen wasö. Gasɨ yad ke nöp auagnö. Bɨ yɨp hag yuö aunö u, nɨpe Bɨ kabö göl, Bɨ manö nɨŋö nöp hagab. Yad nɨpe aip mɨdem, yɨp hag yuö aunö rö, nɨp nɨŋbin; pen kale nɨp nɨŋagpim,” a ga.
Anɨg hagö, nɨp ud sɨsɨ lun a göm nɨŋla u pen ñɨn nɨpe auaga rö, bɨ ap nɨp ud sɨsɨ laga.

Pen nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp Jisas nan gagep gau ga nɨŋöm hagla, “Krais u hain aunab a gɨpal u, pen nan gagep iru yabɨƚ göm, bɨ anɨbi gab rö gɨnɨm rö lagnab,” a gɨla. Gasɨ anɨbu nɨŋöm kale hagla, “Jisas nɨpe Krais u nöp,” a göm, nɨp nɨŋ udla.
Juda bɨ kub gau, Jisas nɨp am dauim, a göm, bɨ rɨmnap hag yula

Pen nɨbi bɨ gau Krais manö anɨbu agamɨj hageila nɨŋöm, Perisi bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, Jisas nɨp am ud sɨsɨ lɨmim daumim, a göm, God sabe gep ram abad mɨdmɨdal polisman rɨmnap hag yula.
Jisas pen haga, “Yad rapɨn magö ap mɨdem, Bɨ yɨp yuö aunö u ado gɨ arnabin.
Yɨp gai aröp a gɨmim uƚhainabim u pen nɨŋagnabim. Yad arnabin adö u, kale hain gɨmim rö lagnab,” a ga.

Anɨg hageia, Juda bɨ kub gau kale ke nöp hagla, “Nɨpe gai arnab, nɨp nɨŋagnabun? Nɨpe am Juda nɨbi bɨ ju am Grik nɨbi bɨ aip mɨdpal gau amöm, nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau kalɨp manö hag ñöl gɨ mɨdeinab aka nɨhön?
Pen nɨpe ai gɨnɨg hagöp, ‘Yɨp gai aröp a gɨmim uƚhainabim u pen nɨŋagnabim. Yad arnabin adö u, kale hain gɨmim rö lagnab,’ a göp?” ö gɨla.
God Ana ñɨg ilam ajöŋ rö juöm aunab
Juda Ram Bada ñɨn kub kale anɨbu, ñɨn hain, ñɨn kub yabɨƚ u, Jisas uraköm, meg magö dap ranöm haga, “Nɨbi bɨ an rugu mɨƚep gɨnɨm u, yad apöm ñɨg ñɨŋöl.
Nɨbi bɨ yɨp nɨŋ udnaböl gau, God Manö hagöp rö, ñɨg kamɨŋ mɨdep u aŋ kalɨp daŋ nɨbö ilam juöm aunab,” a ga.

Ñɨn anɨbu Jisas umöm uraköm Nap nɨp araga adö u me, Jisas nɨpe Ana u nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp ñaga. Pen ñɨg ilam juöm aunab manö haga anɨbu iƚ anɨgöl mɨdöp: nɨbi bɨ Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udnaböl gau, Jisas nɨpe Ana u kalɨp ñɨnab, a göm haga.
Kale ke ud asɨk ke ke lɨla
Jisas anɨg hagö, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp mɨdeila anɨb gau, rɨmnap manö haga anɨbu nɨŋöm hagla, “Bɨ i, nɨpe bɨ God Manö hagep aunab a gun abad mɨdmɨdun u,” a gɨla.
Rɨmnap hagla, “Wasö, nɨpe Krais u!” a gɨla. Anɨg hageila, rɨmnap pen hagla, “Wasö, Jisas nɨpe Galili nɨbö; Krais u nɨpe Galili nɨbö auagnab!
God Manö u hagöp rö, Krais u, Depid rɨkö rɨklö rɨk dam dapɨl göm, Krais u Depid daun nɨpe Bedlehem au yag daunaböl,” a gɨla.
Jisas manö anɨbu hageia nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ iru mɨdeila anɨb gau asɨk ke ke lɨla.
Rɨmnap nɨp ud sɨsɨ lun dam manö kub hagnɨg ud arun a gɨla u pen bɨ añɨ ap nɨp udaga.
Juda bɨ kub gau Jisas manö haga u nɨŋ udagla
Pen God sabe gep ram polisman gau ado gɨ arlö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ Perisi gau abe kalɨp hagla, “Bɨ anɨbu nɨp nɨhön gɨnɨg dauagpim?” ö gɨla.
Hageila, God sabe gep ram polisman anɨb gau hagla, “Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap gau bɨ anɨbu manö aij yabɨƚ hagöp rö hagagpal,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila, pen bɨ Perisi gau pen hagla, “Bɨ pir alöp anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap nɨpe nɨŋö hagöp a göm nɨŋbal rö, kale u rö nöp nɨŋbim ar?
Hon bɨ kub bɨ ap aka bɨ Perisi bɨ ap Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udagpun.
Nɨbi bɨ gai i kale lo manö u nɨŋagpal rö, God kalɨp mulu kal nɨŋöm gɨ naij yabɨƚ gɨnab,” a gɨla.
Pen bɨ kale Nikodimas, bɨ au nöd sɨbön yaŋ amöm, Jisas nɨp manö rɨmnap hag nɨŋa bɨ anɨbu me, kalɨp haga,
“Hon Juda lo adö u, bɨ ap nɨp yɨharɨŋ pen ilön ñun gɨ naij gagnabun; manö kub hagun manö iƚ ap nɨŋun nöp me, anɨg gɨnabun,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia hagla, “Ne u rö nöp Galili nɨbö rö? God Manö u amgö lɨ nɨŋ dammön nɨŋnabön, bɨ God manö hagep ap Galili nɨbö auagnab,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila kale ke ram kale arla.

footnotes.text: God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u nan gagep ñɨg waŋö Bedesda u ga u nɨŋöm pa gɨƚɨ gɨla.
